remarks: Welcome to 1062 Tifft Street, a stunning, fully renovated 4-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home in South Buffalo. Spanning 1,800 square feet, this charming two-story residence blends historic early-1900s craftsmanship with modern upgrades, ideally situated between McKinley Parkway and Southside Parkway. Offering immediate occupancy and high-quality character throughout, this property delivers vibrant city energy paired with a classic neighborhood feel.Step inside to a welcoming entrance foyer with classic hexagon tile. The main level showcases original natural woodwork and rich trim, beautifully paired with brand-new, high-end luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring running through the bright, sun-drenched rooms. Relax in the spacious living room featuring a classic brick fireplace with built-in shelving, which flows effortlessly into a formal dining room and a bright sunroom. The completely updated kitchen boasts sleek new surfaces and brand-new appliances, including an electric range, dishwasher, refrigerator, and microwave. Upstairs, discover four sizable bedrooms with continuous hardwoods, large closets, and a private second-floor balcony off the front bedroom. The full basement adds great functionality with laundry hookups, a half bath, and a dedicated workshop area. Outside, a long concrete driveway leads to a detached 1.5-car garage and a partially fenced backyard perfect for gardening or outdoor gatherings.Location is everything, and this property delivers exceptional access. The home sits just minutes from public transit and the sprawling greenery of Cazenovia Park. Quick access to Tifft Nature Preserve and scenic waterfront views at the Buffalo Outer Harbor make weekend escapes effortless, while Larkinville and Downtown Buffalo are both under a 10-minute drive away. Showings are available immediately for qualified buyers utilizing cash, conventional, FHA, or VA financing options.
